channel.title: DR Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from DR Congo, every source cited.

item.title: US midterm elections may alter Washington's DRC agreements
item.description: The November 3rd US midterm elections could change power dynamics in Washington, affecting future deals.

item.title: Armed men cause fear in Lubero
item.description: Residents of Mwenye, in Lubero territory, Nord-Kivu, are living in fear due to the presence of armed men.

item.title: DR Congo police arrest over 20 corrupt and fake officers
item.description: Kinshasa operation uncovers officers involved in extortion and arbitrary detention.

item.title: Kolwezi residents protest mining pollution
item.description: Residents of Dilungu and Bel Air districts are demanding compensation for housing damage and health issues.

item.title: DR Congo health campaign finds 43 suspected cancer cases
item.description: A health campaign in South and North Kivu screened 113 women and raised awareness among nearly 600 people.
